question: Check whether the accrual-basis election in IRC §170(a)(2) (board authorises in 2025, payment by the 15th day of the 4th month after year-end) was used to deduct early-2026 corporate DAF payments in tax year 2025; look for 'authorized' or 'accrued' charitable contributions in Q1 2026 10-Qs of the PF companies
conclusion_affected: Timing window of a pull-forward (to mid-April 2026 for calendar-year accrual taxpayers)
rationale: §170(a)(2) lets an accrual corporation treat a payment made up to 3.5 months after year-end as paid in the prior year, so a pull-forward need not show as a 2025 cash outflow; no filing read this pass mentions it
